continuous_text.title: What's The Animal?
continuous_text.content:
What's the animal?
Guess! Guess!
What's the animal?
Guess!
[Repeat]

It has a tail and a body,
A nose and a head.
It has two ears.
It has four legs.
It's a cat! It's a cat!
continuous_text.notes: Audio tracks 101 and 102. Includes substitution cues: wings, eyes, beak, legs, two feet, duck.

continuous_text.title: Two Little Ducklings
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1
Narrator: Here's Mommy Duck and two little ducklings.
Mommy Duck: Goodbye, Ducklings!
Ducklings: Bye, Mommy!

Frame 2
Narrator: Here's a cat.
Cat: I'm your mommy. Open the door!

Frame 3
Duckling 1: Look! It has a tail!
Duckling 2: No, no, no! You can't come in!

Frame 4
Narrator: Here's a dog.
Dog: I'm your mommy. Open the door!

Frame 5
Duckling 1: Look! It has ears!
Duckling 2: No, no, no! You can't come in!

Frame 6
Narrator: Here's Mommy Duck.
Mommy Duck: Open the door!

Frame 7
Duckling 1: Show me your beak!
Duckling 2: Show me your wings!
Mommy Duck: This is my beak. These are my wings.

Frame 8
Ducklings: Come in, Mommy!
Mommy Duck: Good job, Ducklings!
continuous_text.speaker_structure: Narrator, Mommy Duck, Ducklings, Cat, Dog
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 4 Story across pages 64 and 65. Illustrates home safety and assessing risk.

continuous_text.title: Diary Entry
continuous_text.content:
February 4th
Dear Diary,
My family has a dog!
It has a white body and a white head. It has a white tail, too. It can run and jump.
I have four pets now - two cats, a hamster, and a dog! My little hamster is my favorite pet.
I don't have a rabbit, but I want a rabbit!
Polina
continuous_text.notes: Lesson 5 Reading passage formatted as a diary entry.

schema_gaps.observed_content: 'Think, Feel, Grow' section on page 65 ('Why does Mommy Duck say Good job? Share your ideas.') explicitly mapped in syllabus (p. 3) to 'Emotional Well-being: Being able to assess risk'.
schema_gaps.problem: The current schema lacks a dedicated entity to track personal safety awareness and risk assessment as social-emotional learning goals.
schema_gaps.reason: Allows capturing explicit risk-assessment and child-safety objectives embedded in stories.
